data.long_meaning: A beautiful woman or one who is adorned with jasmine flowers. The name Azlina carries the meaning “Jasmine” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Malay, Arabic. Parents who choose Azlina usually hope their child will grow to embody jasmine and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azlina total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
